roleTypes.description: Supported role types and their permission groups

name.description:
A predefined permission role or CUSTOM for selecting individual permissions.
ADMIN grants all scoped permissions. GOVERN grants governance, read, write and
delete permissions outside the dedicated management roles. WRITE also grants
read and delete permissions. SYSTEM_MANAGEMENT and USER_MANAGEMENT grant their
respective management permissions. READ and DELETE grant their matching
operation permissions. CUSTOM has no implicit grants.
name.title: ApiPermissionRoleType

groups.description:
Nonempty groups of effective permissions for a predefined role type.
For CUSTOM, these groups contain all selectable scoped permissions.

name.description:
Scoped API permission identifier. READ_ENTITY, WRITE_ENTITY and DELETE_ENTITY
apply to custom entities and presets without dedicated permissions. The PRESET
entity types RetentionPolicy and ReminderPolicy instead require their matching
READ_RETENTION_POLICY, WRITE_RETENTION_POLICY, DELETE_RETENTION_POLICY or
READ_REMINDER_POLICY, WRITE_REMINDER_POLICY, DELETE_REMINDER_POLICY grants.
These dedicated grants cover both entities and their entity type definitions.
Generic entity grants do not grant access to these two preset types.
